message.bedrock_adb.denied: You cannot place or break blocks here
command.bedrock_adb.whitelist.already: %s is already on the bedrock whitelist
command.bedrock_adb.whitelist.not_found: %s is not on the bedrock whitelist
config.bedrock_adb.title: Bedrock ADB Config
option.bedrock_adb.border_mode.tooltip.1: Selects how border blocks treat passing entities.
option.bedrock_adb.border_mode.tooltip.2: Bedrock-like: blocks unprivileged players and monsters; projectiles, spectators, privileged players, vex and the ender dragon may pass.
option.bedrock_adb.border_mode.tooltip.3: Block all entities: everything is blocked except privileged players (OP + creative / whitelist) and spectators.
option.bedrock_adb.require_creative: Privileged players must be in Creative mode
option.bedrock_adb.require_creative.tool: When enabled, bypassing the rules requires permission level 2 AND Creative mode. When disabled, permission level 2 alone is enough.
option.bedrock_adb.op_bypass.tooltip: Allows operators (with the privilege settings above) to place/break utility blocks and pass border blocks.
option.bedrock_adb.show_border_effect.to: Renders a subtle red dust effect around nearby border blocks so the invisible walls can be seen.
